mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM subscription s WHERE parent_user_id=#{user} AND (status='RENEWAL_FAILED' OR (status='ACTIVE' AND auto_renew) OR (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP < ((period_end::timestamp + interval '9 hours') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payment_order o JOIN payment p ON p.order_id=o.id WHERE o.subscription_id=s.id AND p.status='REFUNDED')))
SELECT count(*) FROM refund_request r JOIN payment p ON p.id=r.payment_id JOIN payment_order o ON o.id=p.order_id WHERE o.parent_user_id=#{user} AND r.status IN ('REQUESTED','APPROVED','FAILED')
SELECT count(*) FROM payment p JOIN payment_order o ON o.id=p.order_id WHERE o.parent_user_id=#{user} AND (p.status='CONFIRMING' OR p.entitlement_status='RECOVERY_REQUIRED')
